release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.26 - Paused Session Internet Suspension & Portal Timer Fix

⏸️ Fixed Paused Session Network Blocking
- Forces immediate blockMAC execution (bypasses 15m cooldown guard) when pausing a session
- Instantly flushes active TCP conntrack sockets and inserts FORWARD REJECT rules
- Ensures zero internet access (Google, apps, streaming) while time is paused

⏱️ Frozen Portal Timer UI When Paused
- Fixed frontend startCountdown so countdown interval does not decrement while session is paused
- Displays exact frozen paused time without ticking down or snapping back

🚀 Proceed to Internet Auto-Resume Prompt
- Clicking 'PROCEED TO INTERNET' while paused prompts user to automatically resume their session
